name: Authority confirmation, temporal — an official date, confirmed
purpose: Resolve a date where an official source must agree with independent confirmations.
expected_outcome: RESOLVED with the date the official source states once enough independent publishers confirm it; UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT when the official source says nothing or confirmations disagree.

create_flow_inputs.step_1_question: On what date was the Bitcoin whitepaper first published?
create_flow_inputs.step_8_review_expect: authority policy requires the OFFICIAL source; 2 independent publishers besides it

manual_checks_after_observe: The as-of date on each evidence card appears inside the quoted passage itself.
The claim value is exactly one date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
The summary states how many independent groups confirmed the official claim.
notes: PDFs fetch poorly; point the official source at an HTML mirror if observation marks it UNAVAILABLE — that, too, is a valid test of the missing-page rule.
